verdict.rationale: Galileo is an AI evaluation and observability platform that ships its own AI Assistant, so consuming tools from external MCP servers is a plausible capability and the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only Galileo's own MCP server, which exposes Galileo to IDEs such as Cursor and VS Code. That is the server role and earns no credit for an MCP-client story. Nothing in the pack shows users can register or plug external MCP servers into Galileo for it to call their tools.
